name: Ilia Underwing
desc: Ilia Underwing (Catocala ilia): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 97 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Catocala ilia, the Ilia underwing, beloved underwing or wife underwing, is a moth of the family Erebidae. The species was first described by Pieter Cramer in 1776.
